name: anti-slop
description: Detects and removes LLM slop from business and narrative prose in English and German. 1894 entries (1856 distinct terms) across four grep-checked lists — 517 upstream EQ-Bench, 772 curated English, 496 German, 109 language-neutral (stock names and places, chatbot artifacts, unfilled placeholders) — each curated term carrying a hard/soft severity, plus a flexion-aware checker so German inflected forms are actually found. Lists are never loaded into context.
